newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wool indicator falls 14c to 605c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wool indicator falls 14c to 605c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell by 14 cents to 605 cents a kg clean on Thursday in Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were down, with the 19 micron indicator up to 1.5 percent cheaper.
The 20/22/26m indicators were 2.5 percent cheaper, 21m 2.0 percent cheaper, 23m 4.5 percent cheaper and 24/25m 3.5 percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27m was 1.5 percent cheaper, 28m 1.0 percent cheaper, 29m 0.5 percent cheaper and 30/31m 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, locks slightly dearer and crutchings generally unchanged, WI said.
WI said Japan and Western Europe were the principal buyers.
Of the 14,074 bales offered, 7.6 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney and Adelaide with about 72,500 bales to be offered.
